exposure: Supplemental maternal oxygenation (10 L/min via facemask)
outcome: Umbilical cord arterial and venous pO(2)
cohort: Women with singleton pregnancies undergoing planned cesarean delivery at term
finding: Supplemental maternal oxygenation at 10 L/min during cesarean delivery compared with room air did not significantly change umbilical cord pH values but was associated with a significant increase in umbilical cord arterial and venous O(2) levels.
